project_type: PHP 8.2 + MySQL web application — Government Exam Notification + Mock Test + Blog portal for cPanel shared hosting
language: PHP 8.2, MySQL, Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS
build_system: None — manual PHP includes, no Composer, no Node.js build step. Deployed directly to cPanel public_html. Use `mise use php@8.2` in the project root to activate PHP 8.2.
test_framework: PHP syntax check via: php -l filename.php. Full functional check by running: find . -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \;
verification_instructions:
1. Run PHP lint on all files: find . -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \;
2. Check file structure matches spec
3. Check .htaccess is valid
4. Check that no hardcoded API keys exist (grep for actual API keys in non-config files)
setup_instructions:
1. cd /projects/sandbox/examduniya-
2. mise use php@8.2 (switches to PHP 8.2)
3. All files placed directly in repo root (maps to public_html on cPanel)
4. DB credentials only in config/db.php
5. PHPMailer source files bundled in includes/PHPMailer/
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network — cannot download packages. All CDN resources (Bootstrap 5.3, Chart.js, Google Fonts Inter, Font Awesome) referenced as CDN links in HTML. PHPMailer must be written/bundled as source files in the repo. No Docker, no Node.js, no Composer. TCPDF for PDF generation must also be bundled as source. PHP 8.2 via mise.
contribution_requirements: cPanel shared hosting compatibility: no shell_exec, no proc_open in production code. All external calls via cURL. Clean URLs via .htaccess mod_rewrite.
key_patterns: All API keys/tokens from settings MySQL table via get_setting() helper. PDO prepared statements everywhere. CSRF tokens on all forms. htmlspecialchars() on all output. Admin checks role===admin on every admin page. Functions in includes/functions.php. Config only in config/db.php.
directory_structure: Root = public_html equivalent. config/ = DB only. includes/ = shared PHP includes + PHPMailer source. pages/ = public pages. admin/ = admin panel. auth/ = login/signup/oauth. api/ = AJAX endpoints. assets/ = CSS/JS. uploads/ = user-uploaded files.
